newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka 1997 rice imports seen at 450,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka 1997 rice imports seen at 450,000 T.

text.p: Sri Lanka's rice imports in 1997 are seen at 450,000 tonnes largely due a shift in consumption patterns, a top finance ministry official said on Wednesday.
P.B. Jayasundera, deputy secretary of Treasury, told Reuters in an interview that Sri Lanka imported 300,000 tonnes of rice in 1996.
Jayasundera said the lowering of a wheat subsidy last year had raised flour prices and increased rice consumption.
"So naturally, even if (the rice) harvest was good, there was more demand for rice together with a slight reduction in wheat consumption," he said.
An agriculture ministry official said last month that Sri Lanka did not plan to import rice until August as the current crop had been satisfactory.
Sri Lanka's annual rice demand is about 1.9 million tonnes.
